A “6/10” tells a student where they stand. It doesn’t tell them what to do next. 📝

Good feedback is:
✅ Specific: point to the exact line
✅ Actionable: say what to change
✅ Fast: return copies while the test is fresh
✅ Acted on: let them redo one answer

Swipe to see a real checked copy where one line of feedback says more than four red crosses. 👉

Good feedback takes time, and most teachers don’t have enough of it. PARTHU.AI gives detailed feedback on every copy, so you don’t have to pick between speed and detail.
